description: This file is a JavaScript module used for setting up and executing test runs with Vitest, managing locks during testing, and cleaning up temporary files.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures that the lock acquired by acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync is released only once.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Deletes temporary include files associated with a test spec to ensure cleanup.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a Vitest test specification, manages the test process, and handles cleanup.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates the default test specification for a root test run, configuring arguments for Vitest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point executing the test process, managing lock release and process termination based on test outcomes.
